Avesh Fresh Meat Shop Thru. Proprietor ... vs State Of U.P.
Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 15 May, 2025

Author: Rajan Roy
Bench: Rajan Roy
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Writ - C No. - 4542 of 2025
Petitioner :- Avesh Fresh Meat Shop Thru. Proprietor Salamuddeen
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Food And Civil Supplies Lko.

And
Counsel for Petitioner :- Raj Deepak Chaudhary,Virendra Singh
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1. Heard.
2.

Prima facie, we find merit in the contention of petitioner's counsel that the procedure prescribed
under Section 32 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (in short 'the Act, 2006'), sub-Section
2 of which permits suspension of licence if the food business operator fails to comply with an
improvement notice, has not been followed nor any improvement notice has been given nor the
provisions contained in para no.2.1.8 of the Food Safety And Standards (Licensing and Registration
Avesh Fresh Meat Shop Thru. Proprietor ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 15 May, 2025
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132261369/
1

of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011 have been followed nor do the reasons given in the impugned
order of suspension of license are referable to the grounds mentioned in the said provisions.

entities.text: Avesh Fresh Meat Shop Thru. Proprietor ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. At this stage, Sri Akansha Dubey, learned Addl. C.S.C. says that in fact the order may be quashed
with liberty to the opposite parties to proceed afresh if there is a case in terms of the aforesaid
provision.

4. We, accordingly, quash the impugned order but with liberty to the opposite parties to proceed
afresh provided there is a cause referable to the provisions of the Act, 2006 and the Regulations
made thereunder.
5.  Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.

(Om Prakash Shukla,J.) (Rajan Roy,J.) Order Date :- 15.5.2025 Shanu/-
